Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics part of this study is focused on interactome mapping (AP-MS) using endogenously tagged proteins to define the composition of the CPSF and m6A writer complexes. While the broader paper describes differential RNA-seq and Nanopore data using AID-mediated knockdowns (IAA treatment), the MS data (PXD024326) specifically corresponds to the interactome analysis of the tagged lines. Therefore, the primary biological variable for the MS experiment is the genetic modification (tagging) of the bait proteins.
